semantics.pointerDown: capture pointer; follow immediately; route grabNext from actually displayed frame, no seated closing prerequisite
semantics.pointerUp: freeze destination world anchor; replace unplayed queue with releaseNext from displayed frame
semantics.repeatedRelease: no-op if already landing; do not restart
semantics.regrab: cancel pending release queue; world plate fades in place; route grabNext from displayed contact/grip
semantics.windowTranslation: pointer root only, never interpreted as body-pose synthesis

knownGaps: core entry/early-release and corrected hug-tail have limited v4 peer acceptance; not final smoothness acceptance
native pointer/window/world stool integration QA pending
